text: What changes the rate? First, the nature of the reactants. Ionic reactions are instant because no covalent bond must break. And surface area. A marble chip in dilute hydrochloric acid fizzes slowly. The same mass, powdered, fizzes furiously, because far more surface is exposed. That is why limestone is crushed before it goes into a lime kiln.
